title: Retrieved But Not Reliable: A Survey on Attacks, and Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge, improving factuality and reducing hallucinations. At the same time, the retrieval-augmented pipeline introduces new robustness and security risks, including corpus poisoning, backdoor attacks, privacy leakage, and fairness violations. Despite rapid progress in this area, existing surveys remain limited in their treatment of attacker objectives, threat models, and stage-specific defenses across the full RAG pipeline. This survey presents a unified and pipeline-aware overview of RAG robustness. We formalize threat models over the corpus, retriever, and generator, and organize attacks into three main objectives: accuracy, privacy, and fairness. We further review defenses from a pipeline-aware perspective, covering the retrieval, rerank, generation, and traceback stages. In addition, we summarize robustness benchmarks and explain

translated_title: 检索但不可靠：检索增强生成中的攻击与防御综述
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将输出基于外部知识来增强大型语言模型，提高事实准确性并减少幻觉。同时，检索增强流水线引入了新的鲁棒性和安全风险，包括语料库投毒、后门攻击、隐私泄露和公平性违规。尽管该领域进展迅速，现有综述在处理攻击者目标、威胁模型以及整个RAG流水线中各阶段特定防御方面仍存在局限性。本综述提供了统一且流水线感知的RAG鲁棒性概述。我们形式化了语料库、检索器和生成器上的威胁模型，并将攻击组织为三个主要目标：准确性、隐私和公平性。我们进一步从流水线感知的角度审查防御措施，涵盖检索、重排序、生成和追溯阶段。此外，我们总结了鲁棒性基准并进行了说明。
tldr: 本综述统一了检索增强生成全流水线中的攻击与防御框架，按准确性、隐私和公平性分类威胁模型，并覆盖各阶段防御策略。
en_tdlr: This survey unifies attack and defense frameworks across the full RAG pipeline, categorizing threat models by accuracy, privacy, and fairness, and covering stage-specific defenses.
